pool.notes: Inline branches; each label is an IMPORT. Pool-wide guarantee: route != isolated (early return). The branches read institution NAMES by private substring (smith/metalwork/farm/granar/carpenter/sawmill), not factsOf(r).hasInstitution, so the institution presumption is declared on the row. Merged into economicState.necessityImports, then into deriveImportsFromChains (survives the stage-7 override).

rows.notes: Branch: no local salt commodity, route not port/river (same route reader: noted), no salt_* resource. producer: unhomed: salt source.
Branch: tier city|metropolis (guaranteed), no local iron, no smith/metalwork by name (private regex; declared). producer elsewhere: institution: mine.
Branch: no local grain commodity AND (port OR city+) AND no farm/granary by name. The granary exclusion is odd (a granary stores imports); not declared. producer: food-source: grain (elsewhere).
Branch: tier city+ (guaranteed), no carpenter/sawmill by name. unhomed: sawmill/carpenter (no institution kind).
